metaTitle: Custom Poly Spandex Jackets | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom poly spandex jackets in bulk. Perfect for teams, events, and uniforms. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Poly spandex jackets offer a stretchy, form-fitting option that moves with the wearer, making them ideal for active teams, outdoor events, or corporate uniforms where comfort and flexibility matter. Unlike rigid shell jackets, the spandex blend provides four-way stretch and a soft hand feel. These custom jackets can be decorated with screen printing or embroidery for a polished look that lasts through repeated wear.
heroAltText: Custom poly spandex jackets in various colors, featuring a full zip and embroidered logo
